apiEvidence.legacyOwnershipProjection: exact top-level pub-use and public-module ownership projection
apiEvidence.completeCandidateApi: normalized rustdoc JSON types methods fields variants and signatures
apiEvidence.semverPolicy: existing public path removal or fingerprint mutation rejects; additions reported

digestContracts.promptDeliveryV1: frozen historical custom commitment; not HPTC and never reinterpreted
digestContracts.promptDeliveryV2: HPTC schema 2 with optional exact V1 migration witness
digestContracts.runtimeTopologyCandidateV1: HPTC V1 binds every semantic candidate and delta field; candidate_digest is derived
digestContracts.manifestProtocols: strict JSON is transport only; validated native values project to HPTC V1 semantic commitments
digestContracts.registeredNumericConversionV2: receipt binds registry generation/digest, profile definitions, normalizer and base conversion receipt; owner-current admission additionally requires verify_for_snapshot against an independently pinned snapshot

orderingContracts.RuntimeTopologyCandidateV1.deltas: set semantics represented as a strictly increasing StableId sequence; non-canonical order rejects
orderingContracts.RuntimeTopologyDeltaV1.related_module_id: set semantics represented as a strictly increasing StableId sequence; duplicate, self or non-canonical order rejects

productOwners: utility.ndu registered numeric owner with owner-pinned snapshot verification
runtime.codex prompt producer and learning.ledger durable compatibility consumer

candidateEvidence.sourceHead: candidate identity kind source-head; source SHA equals candidate SHA
candidateEvidence.syntheticMerge: candidate identity kind synthetic-merge; exact source and base SHAs are direct parents of the candidate
candidateEvidence.gitProvenance: exact HEAD tree, root trees and tracked blob identities
candidateEvidence.publicApi: base and candidate rustdoc JSON normalized semver comparison
candidateEvidence.properties: deterministic mutation checks plus bounded coverage-guided libFuzzer
candidateEvidence.independentReview: separate exact-current-head governance evidence; excludes PR author and every candidate commit author/committer and is conditionally fanned into blocking-ci CI required
candidateEvidence.authoritativeReceipts: emitted only after truth, catalog, consumers, provenance, API, MSRV, native, Miri, fuzz and bundle outcomes pass
candidateEvidence.implementationMap: runtime exact checked-out commit/tree plus SHA-256 of the committed public inventory and detailed implementation map; historical committed sourceBase and observedAtHead values are non-authoritative provenance

nonClaims: No V1 prompt digest is relabeled as HPTC.
No registry generation is authenticated, published or advanced by platform.types; verify_for_snapshot only enforces equality with an independently pinned owner snapshot.
No manifest contract executes randomness, inventories a host, drives a sensor or grants authority.
No JSON serialization byte sequence is used as a semantic digest.
No source-tree receipt may qualify a synthetic merge, and no synthetic-merge receipt may qualify a source tree.
Independent review evidence is not a source qualification receipt.
Failure diagnostics are not qualification receipts.
Production activation, deployment qualification, operator acceptance and release are not claimed.
